# External Source Discovery and Recovery Backlog

**Created:** 2026-08-15  
**Purpose:** Record unacquired carriers and provenance work without inventing or duplicating source evidence.

## 1. Original publisher and broadcaster carriers

The acquired B01-B26 files are Accio Quote preservation transcripts. Search for lawful originals from these outlets before raising their authority:

- B01-B02 — Scholastic.com live chats.
- B03 — AOL Live.
- B04 — World Book Day.
- B05-B07 — MuggleNet / The Leaky Cauldron three-part interview; preserve the three parts as one interview set.
- B08 — ITV / Edinburgh press conference.
- B09 — Bloomsbury web chat; compare the contemporary Leaky Cauldron transcript at https://www.the-leaky-cauldron.org/2007/07/30/j-k-rowling-web-chat-transcript/.
- B10 — PotterCast / The Leaky Cauldron; compare Part 1 at https://www.the-leaky-cauldron.org/2007/12/23/transcript-of-part-1-of-pottercast-s-jk-rowling-interview/ and the later Part 2 transcript at https://www.the-leaky-cauldron.org/2008/01/02/pottercast-131-j-k-rowling-interview-transcript/.
- B11-B26 — The Herald, Guardian Unlimited, Salon, Barnes & Noble, Boston Globe / Student NewsLine, WBUR, WAMU, South West News Service, Yahoo!, Raincoast Books, BBC, and Radio City Music Hall carriers named in the manifest.

When an original is recovered, attach it as another carrier of the existing logical B ID. Do not create independent corroborating evidence merely because both the original and Accio transcript exist.

## 2. Old J.K. Rowling website

Use these only as discovery and provenance indexes until an original archived capture is recovered:

- https://www.hp-lexicon.org/source/guide-to-rowling-website/
- https://www.hp-lexicon.org/source/other-canon/jkr/
- https://www.therowlinglibrary.com/j-k-rowling/official-website/

For each recovered item, retain the original `jkrowling.com` URL, Wayback capture URL and timestamp, page category, visible title/date, and whether the local text is an archived original or a preservation transcription.

Priority topics are Hogwarts, FAQs, wizard-of-the-month records, extra-stuff pages, desk/news updates, WOMBAT material, and any pages that clarify school governance, staff, curriculum, founders, admissions, architecture, or pre-1984 history.

## 3. Published and physical Rowling-authored sources

Acquire only from legitimate local editions or lawful recordings:

- E01 — *Hogwarts: An Incomplete and Unreliable Guide*.
- E02 — *Short Stories from Hogwarts of Heroism, Hardship and Dangerous Hobbies*.
- E03 — *Short Stories from Hogwarts of Power, Politics and Pesky Poltergeists*.
- E04 — *Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald — The Original Screenplay*.
- E05 — *Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore — The Complete Screenplay*; preserve joint authorship with Steve Kloves.
- E06 — original Famous Wizard Cards; use https://www.hp-lexicon.org/source/other-canon/fw/ to enumerate editions and variants.
- E07 — the four official fan-club *Daily Prophet* newsletters; use https://www.hp-lexicon.org/source/other-canon/dp/ for issue enumeration and continuity cautions.
- E08 — the 2008 Waterstones prequel in *What's Your Story?*.
- E09 — Lindsey Fraser's *Conversations with J.K. Rowling*.
- E10 — ITV's *J.K. Rowling: A Year in the Life* with timestamps and a lawful recording or broadcaster transcript.

Map E01-E03 sections to equivalent HarryPotter.com originals before extraction so different carriers do not inflate evidence weight.

## 4. Completeness audits

- Independently enumerate the paginated HarryPotter.com J.K. Rowling archive. The 37 acquired pages are verified high-relevance candidates, but this pass did not prove that no other relevant article exists beyond the archive page's initially exposed results.
- Exhaust the Accio Hogwarts topic index at https://www.accio-quote.org/themes/hogwarts.htm and chronological indexes for 1997-2007.
- Validate exact publication dates for B13 Salon and B18 Diane Rehm before normalizing their manifest dates.
- Locate surviving audio for B17 WBUR, B25 BBC Radio 4, and B26 Radio City Music Hall; keep transcript and audio as carriers of the same logical source.
- Inspect the HP Lexicon source archive for additional Rowling-authored card, newsletter, website, and promotional material, but retain the Lexicon as discovery authority E unless it hosts a clearly attributed preservation transcription.
